Atlas & Biomechanics – To better understand the possibilities in holistic animal care of the horses. 

The ABC of the Horse books is designed to be used by veterinarians, students, and physiotherapists and for all those interested in horse welfare. These unique and comprehensive books should be on every horse person’s bookshelf.
